acceptance_criteria.description: Validated HTTPS and literal-loopback HTTP bases derive only the canonical wss/ws /v1/realtime endpoint with the exact authority and no second endpoint input.
Each mint call emits exactly one bounded authenticated POST to /v1/realtime/tickets with strict JSON and no redirect, and returns a typed Unauthorized only for HTTP 401.
Response Content-Length and streamed bodies are capped at 8 KiB; malformed, oversized, redirected, non-success, and transport responses fail with stable secret-free errors.
Exact request correlation precedes consuming into_parts, and the ticket moves without cloning into a validated RealtimeGrant; mismatch, expiry, and excessive TTL fail closed.
Tests prove exact path/method/body/bearer handling, no query or subprotocol ticket channel, endpoint conversion, redirect denial, size boundaries, correlation, and redacted Debug/error behavior.
Focused and full coop-launcher tests, strict Clippy, formatting, and diff checks pass with changes confined to owned files.

closed_decisions: Create an additive launcher realtime module/API; do not widen the existing CloudApi trait or break its fakes.
ReqwestCloudApi mints only with POST v1/realtime/tickets, its existing private no-redirect client, and the active AuthSession access token in the Authorization Bearer header.
Use an 8 KiB maximum response body with Content-Length preflight and streamed cumulative enforcement before strict MintRealtimeTicketResponse decoding.

Preserve HTTP 401 as a stable Unauthorized result so the later session coordinator can perform exactly one refresh-and-new-mint attempt. Collapse all other status, transport, parse, oversize, and redirect results without peer text.
The HTTP adapter performs one request per call and never retries, refreshes, follows redirects, connects WebSocket, or logs request/response/header bodies.

Derive the WebSocket endpoint exclusively from the already validated ReqwestCloudApi base: https becomes wss, literal-loopback http becomes ws, authority and explicit port are retained, and the exact path is /v1/realtime with no query, fragment, or userinfo.

Require MintRealtimeTicketResponse::matches_request before consuming it. Then call into_parts and move the non-Clone ticket directly into RealtimeGrant::with_now using the caller-supplied authenticated timestamp.

Reject mismatched versions/fences and expired or excessive-TTL grants with stable secret-free errors. Never copy, serialize, expose, debug, persist, or transfer the ticket outside the Authorization header used later by the in-process core.
No new crate dependency or Cargo.lock change is needed. Keep the existing endpoint policy and all auth/session/checkpoint behavior unchanged.
forbidden_changes: Do not edit Cargo files, process.rs, session.rs, main.rs, sidecar/cloud/server/ROM/Lua code, documentation, generated artifacts, or orchestration state.
Do not implement refresh/retry orchestration, control pumps, WebSocket transport, background tasks, or process supervision in this unit.
Do not accept a caller-provided arbitrary WebSocket endpoint, put tickets in URL/query/frames/IPC/argv/environment/files/logs, clone secret text, or return peer-controlled error bodies.

Do not stage, commit, branch, fetch, pull, push, contact repository remotes, create or remove worktrees, or revert another worker's edits. You are not alone in the codebase; preserve all edits outside your owned files.
objective: Add the launcher-owned, credential-safe HTTP and grant-construction seam for one realtime attempt: canonical endpoint derivation, bounded authenticated ticket minting, exact response correlation, and consuming ticket handoff.

return_when: All acceptance criteria are resolved and required verification outcomes are recorded.
A safe implementation requires changing a forbidden credential, endpoint, core, control, or session boundary.
A concrete toolchain or isolated-worktree failure prevents further progress within the execution budget.
